name: Feller
title: Charter feller
examine: Six on the licence, three on the wains, three at the cut. Counts the hands at the end of the day.
lines: Up to the string and past it. She says the far side is dying and it is. It splits like bread.
We lost one in the summer. Thirty feet in. Nobody says his name here and it is not because we forgot it.
Something takes a snag off the pile at night and leaves a bone on the rope. Bodil says it is a tidy thief. I say it is paying.
